significance: A Monument of National Importance at Wadhwan on the Bhogavo, maintained by the Archaeological Survey of India. It carries the first known use of the grass-patti moulding, a band that recurs throughout later western Indian temple building.
story: Ranakdevi, queen of the Chudasama ruler Khengara, is said to have been carried off by the Chaulukya king Jayasimha Siddharaja and to have become sati on this spot.
